competitors.what_they_have: Service page that ranks for the commercial super refund queries. Title leads with the exact query (スーパーアニュエーション返金申請). Eligibility list, 'which fund am I in', 'how much comes back' (33 to 35% for WHM), 4-step process with progress graphic, certifier handling, flat listed fee, TPB/industry logos. No FAQ, no ATO sources, footer dated 2013 to 2020. Pays to Australian bank account only, 1 to 2 months.

Updated July 2026. Three-condition eligibility, tax-rate table (65% / 35% / 0%), 6-step timeline split into before departure and after departure, checklist (TFN, passport, fund name, member number, USI, bank), 6-month rule, FAQ (years later, cost, student to WHM switch). Cites ATO, Home Affairs, myGov. Gets the $5,000 rule half wrong and says nothing about ATO-held super payout limits or Payday Super.

March 2026. Visa tax-rate table, 'how to check your balance', explicit H3 for the 5,000豪ドル rule (certified copies), steps, FAQ (years later, 28 days, DIY), advice to keep the Australian account open and avoid cheques.

First-person walkthrough of the ATO DASP online form field by field (TFN, passport, 417, fund, member number, employer dates), real figures from one claim (2,365 AUD balance, 828 AUD received, 34 days). Strong E-E-A-T signal through experience; no certification or ATO-held coverage.
Rate-only article (65% vs 35%/45%, DASP not on the tax return), dated July 2026. No sources, no steps.
Screenshot-by-screenshot ATO online application, fund withdrawal form, FAQ x5. Claims super is forfeited after 5 years, which the ATO pages do not say; our page should not repeat or rebut it by name.

gap_summary: Every top-5 result has a before/after-departure checklist and a visa tax-rate table; we have neither as a scannable block. Nobody covers two ATO facts we can own: ATO-held super can only be paid to an Australian account in your name or by cheque, and certified copies are best done while still in Australia. Our page also states a wrong rate for the untaxed element and a too-broad 65% rule; both are P1 fact fixes before any growth work.

facts.fact: Working holiday makers: 65% on the taxed element and 65% on the untaxed element where the DASP includes contributions made while on a WHM visa; otherwise 35% taxed / 45% untaxed; tax-free component 0%. Mixed-visa cases: fund applies 65% if only a WHM visa with work rights was held, else ordinary rates.
DASP 65% rate for working holiday makers effective 1 July 2017.
Eligibility: entered on an eligible temporary visa (not 405/410), visa no longer in effect, departed Australia, not an Australian/NZ citizen or permanent resident.
You can only submit a DASP application once you have left Australia and do not hold an active visa; you can start and save an online application while still in Australia.

Where your super is $5,000 or more, your fund may require certified copies of your ID; ATO advises certifying while still in Australia. Below $5,000, evidence of departure and visa expiry without a Certification of Immigration Status, though a fund may still ask.
DASP generally paid within 28 days of the completed application being received; longer if incomplete.
Funds transfer super to the ATO when 6 months or more have passed since you left Australia and your visa has ceased.
International money transfer is only available for applications to super funds (fees may apply). For ATO-held super you can only choose EFT to an Australian bank account in your name or a cheque.
The DASP online application system is free; it can search for your super once you have met eligibility and provided your TFN.
Paper form NAT 7204 goes to each fund separately; each fund makes a separate payment.
Superannuation Guarantee 12% from 1 July 2025, unchanged 2026-27; Payday Super from 1 July 2026 requires most employers to pay within days of each payday.
ATO DASP page last updated 21 April 2026.
